schedule: Start by simplifying the goal and hypotheses using simp.
claim: none: an exploratory pilot (n=45, about 9% power for the paper's 19 wins vs 3 losses split; ~170 targets for 80%). It checks the checkpoint generates 16 usable samples per target per arm and estimates discordance. A confirmatory run, if any, is sized from it and frozen in its own manifest; pilot rows are never pooled into it.
endpoint: kernel acceptance in any of the 16 samples (pass@16), per target per arm; all 16 are generated and judged; first_accept_index is the counterfactual early-stop cost, generated/tokens/seconds the actual one
primary: skeleton vs alone, exact two-sided sign test on the targets only one arm solved (the 2026-10-28 rule), over targets complete in both arms
scope: operational re-solving of public solved targets by one fp16 copy of the open BF16 checkpoint on vLLM; not the router lane mistral-ministral-3b-2512 and not unseen-theorem generalization; model memorization not ruled out
system: tools/attempt.py SYSTEM, both arms, with the checkpoint's chat template; its SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt is not used
adaptation: the paper prefixes a completion model's output with the skeleton; this chat model is asked in the prompt to begin with it, and each row counts the answers that did (skeleton_followed)
source: Burton, Structured Hints for Sample-Efficient Lean Theorem Proving, arXiv 2601.16172, Appendix A (read 2026-11-08)
supersedes_transport_of: skeleton-pilot-2026-11-08 (refused by lane_budget in run 42496660867: 150 calls a day on the router lane)
max_tokens_why: 1024 is the paper's, for a completion prover writing only the proof; smoke 20261108T1747 of manifest skeleton-pilot-kaggle-2026-11-08 cut all 8 samples at exactly 1024 tokens (2048 per 2-sample arm), and the router lane's 30 metered rejects have median 1,202 completion tokens. 4000 is the house cap for the small-model series (headtohead.ROUTER_MAX_TOKENS, tools/toolscore.py). Same value in both arms.
supersedes: skeleton-pilot-kaggle-2026-11-08 (smoke only; no pilot rows under it)
